title: Software Engineer Analyst III (Front-End)
description:
Empresa está contratando Software Engineer Analyst III (Front-End) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 150,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.  Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.  At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!  Hello, developer! We have a special opportunity for you, but first, let's see if it makes sense for you!  If you are passionate about providing exceptional user experiences, have a strategic eye for metrics, and feel at home in high-performance, scalable distributed environments, we want you to technically lead our projects with us.  Come to work as a Software Engineer Analyst III. You will be part of our development team, where your role will be fundamental in leading the development and architecture of modern web applications and being a key player in creating amazing new products for our clients. Our team builds products on a global scale with many direct integrations, including with Meta (Facebook) for messaging.  Responsibilities   Lead the delivery of technology projects and products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs), actively influencing the product team with suggestions and new features.  Mentor other developers, promoting best development practices and ensuring code quality through rigorous code reviews.  Define and architect scalable Front-End systems for our robust, global messaging platform (for channels like WhatsApp and SMS).  Make architectural decisions and develop interfaces for incredible integrations and conversational experiences using modern technologies.  Lead technical discussions, define the direction for solutions, and collaborate to solve our clients' most complex problems, helping to scale our solution.  Ensure excellence in code versioning (Git) and Pull Request processes.  Master integrations and communications using REST APIs, proposing improvements and new standards.    Requirements   Vast and proven experience in HTML, CSS, and Javascript.  Advanced and solid experience in development with Angular.  Deep knowledge of Reactive Programming with Signals (Angular 16+).  Mastery of Redux/Ngrx for state management, including architecting complex solutions with actions, reducers, effects, and selectors.  Profound knowledge of system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and the application of design patterns in complex scenarios.  Solid experience with agile development methodologies, acting as a technical reference for the team.  Solid experience with Unit and Integration Testing, including defining testing strategies.  Experience with creating and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions).  Solid knowledge of relational databases.    Bonus Experience   Front-End Performance and Optimization: Deep knowledge of tools and techniques to optimize application performance, such as bundle size analysis (Webpack Bundle Analyzer), code-splitting, lazy loading, and improving Core Web Vitals.  Front-End Observability: Experience with tools for monitoring front-end applications, like Sentry, Datadog RUM, or similar platforms, to track errors and user experience.  Design Systems: Experience in building, maintaining, or contributing to a scalable design system or component library (e.g., using Storybook).  Advanced Testing: Practical experience with End-to-End (E2E) testing frameworks like Cypress or Playwright.  Monorepo Architecture: Familiarity with managing front-end projects within a monorepo (e.g., using Nx, Lerna).    Preferred Attributes   Enjoy working in a team with talented people and raising the team's technical bar by seeking new solutions, challenging the status quo, and improving existing processes.  Have the autonomy and proactivity to lead initiatives and adapt quickly to change.  Possess excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships with different teams and hierarchical levels, being able to translate technical requirements for stakeholders.  In short, we are looking for someone willing to dive deep into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always striving for continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.    English Language Proficiency   As we are a global company, English is essential. In your daily work, you will need to communicate with teams around the world. We expect you to have fluency or, at a minimum, professional proficiency in English to participate in technical discussions and collaborate effectively.  If you enjoy challenges like designing complex application architecture, creating exceptional user experiences at scale, and optimizing performance for a global audience, we have these and other topics on our team's agenda. If you identify with this challenge and want to technically lead projects with a global impact, let's have a chat to get to know our challenges up close!  Hiring Process  We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.  We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page:  No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!  Benefits   Stay healthy:  We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.  Flexible benefits:  With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance. Realizar a gestão de pagamentos e de saldos contratuais e orçamentários de fornecedores das ferramentas e soluções de crédito, através de acompanhamento contínuo, garantindo o cumprimento das obrigações e a manutenção do uso. For this reason, we value diversity and we strive to always push each other forward to build an inclusive workplace where every employee feels like they belong, where they can grow and find meaning.  WELCOME TO BRP  We’re a world leader in recreational vehicles and boats, creating innovative ways to move on snow, water, asphalt, dirt and even in the air. Headquartered in the Canadian town of Valcourt, Quebec, our company is rooted in a spirit of ingenuity and intense customer focus. Today, we operate manufacturing facilities in Canada, the United States, Mexico, Finland, Australia and Austria, with a workforce made of close to 17,000 spirited people, all driven by the deeply held belief that at work, as with life itself, it’s not about the destination; It’s about the journey. title: Auxiliar Veterinário(a) (Campinas)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Auxiliar Veterinário(a) (Campinas) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

O Hospital Veterinário VFP é tido como referência na medicina veterinária intensiva no quesito qualidade e inovação no Brasil com unidades em Ribeirão Preto, Araraquara, São José dos Campos e Uberlândia. Novas unidades serão inauguradas em Uberaba, Franca, Piracicaba e São José do Rio Preto.  Nós vivemos sob a cultura de aprendizagem, com valorização de stakeholders e com as melhores tecnologias do mercado para que a assistência médica veterinária seja eficiente.  Se você busca um ambiente inovador e de excelência em medicina veterinária intensiva, venha fazer parte do Hospital VFP!  Responsabilidades e atribuições  As responsabilidades e atribuições do cargo de auxiliar são:   Responsável pelos parâmetros.  Responsável por toda a alimentação dos pacientes.  Responsável pela organização e limpeza das internações: limpeza dos canis, higiene dos pacientes e limpeza geral das internações durante todo o período.  Responsável pelas prescrições de medicamentos.  Responsável pela conferência de acessos venosos periféricos, sondagens e demais tubos.  Responsável pela coleta de amostras para exames.  Responsável pelo registro de observações dos pacientes no prontuário de internação (necessidades fisiológicas, temperamento, parâmetros extras, comportamento).  Responsável pela organização e conservação da limpeza da clínica.  Responsável pelo atendimento telefônico e portaria quando necessário.  Responsável pela checagem da esterilização de materiais.    Observação: os auxiliares veterinários se dividem entre as responsabilidades e auxiliam em outras tarefas como sondagem uretral, sondagem nasogástrica, passeio com pacientes internados, enemas, manutenção e conservação de equipamentos, checagem de pontos de oxigênio, auxílio na abordagem emergencial, auxílio a equipe cirúrgica/anestésica com contenção, medicação pré-anestésica, intubação orotraqueal, posicionamento do paciente, separação de material necessário à cirurgia, tricotomia, antissepsia inicial do sítio cirúrgico, apoio volante durante o procedimento cirúrgico e procedimento para embalagem do corpo após o óbito.  Requisitos e qualificações  Os profissionais que atuam nesse setor devem ser empáticos e solícitos, já que suas ações podem ser decisivas para o bem-estar do paciente e para a qualidade da assistência médica veterinária. Todos os profissionais passam por treinamentos específicos para estarem aptos ao serviço de urgência e emergência.  Os candidatos devem possuir curso de auxiliar ou técnico veterinário ou estar cursando Medicina Veterinária a partir do 3º semestre. Além disso, é necessário ter experiência comprovada nas atribuições do cargo.  Informações adicionais  Os benefícios oferecidos pelo Hospital VFP são:   Vale transporte  Descontos nos serviços e produtos  Wellhub para facilitar acesso a diversas academias no Brasil     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: MEIO OFICIAL TORNEIRO MEC NICO
description:
Confira a oportunidade para MEIO OFICIAL TORNEIRO MEC NICO em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

O Grupo TEADIT atua mundialmente no desenvolvimento de soluções para Vedação Industrial e Juntas de Expansão, que protegem o meio ambiente e milhares de pessoas contra fluidos químicos agressivos. A Teadit opera 6 plantas de produção: duas no Brasil (Itatiba, Campinas), uma nos EUA, Áustria, Argentina e Índia, além de postos de atendimento espalhados globalmente. A variedade de soluções de vedação desenvolvida pelo Grupo Teadit está presente nas maiores indústrias do mundo, garantindo o perfeito funcionamento operacional com foco na redução de vazamentos.  Responsabilidades e atribuições   Operar torno convencional, fresa convencional, retifica cilíndrica e plana  Trocar ou ajustar peças de equipamentos e máquinas.  Ler e interpretar desenhos técnicos.  Montar e desmontar equipamentos e máquinas para reparos e manutenção.  Lubrificar equipamentos e máquinas.  Confeccionar pequenas peças de aço com corte e solda.  Torno Convencional/CNC: Prender as peças na placa, centralizar e nivelar com relógio comparador, realizar a usinagem conforme o desenho;  Fresa: Fixar as peças na morsa, centralizar, nivelar e usinar;  Retífica: Fixar as peças na mesa magnética e usinar;  Acabamento: Retirar as rebarbas das peças;  Regular os mecanismos da máquina, estabelecendo a velocidade ideal, graduando os dispositivos de controle automático e controlando o fluxo de lubrificante sobre o gume da ferramenta;  Afiar Ferramentas.    Requisitos e qualificações   Ensino Médio Completo (Desejável Técnico Mecânico);  Cursos de Torneiro Mecânico, Mecânico Geral, Torneiro CNC ou equivalentes (Concluído);  Noções de Instrumentos de Medicação como: Calibrador, micrômetro, esquadro, relógio comparador, mandris e etc.;  Noções de Desenho Técnico;  Disponibilidade para atuar em horário administrativo e esporadicamente no 2º turno.    Benefícios   Assistência médica;  Assistência odontológica;  Seguro de vida em grupo;  Refeição no local;  Vale alimentação;  Convênio farmácia;  Vale transporte ou transporte fretado; (dependendo da localidade)  Estacionamento no local;  Participação nos lucros e resultados anual (PLR).     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Gerente de Produto e Serviços Técnicos Sênior SAR
description:

A Phibro Animal Health Corporation é uma organização global de capital aberto com uma rica história em saúde e nutrição animal que fabrica e comercializa aditivos medicamentosos para alimentação animal, vacinas, produtos de especialidades nutricionais e nutrição mineral. Nós nos esforçamos para ser um parceiro confiável para os produtores de gado, aves, suínos e aquacultura, agricultores, veterinários e consumidores que criam ou cuidam de animais de produção e de companhia, fornecendo soluções para ajudá-los a manter e melhorar a saúde de seus animais.  A Phibro é uma empresa diversificada. Além de nutrição e saúde animal, fabricamos e comercializamos produtos para melhorar a performance na produção de etanol, microbianos para plantas, aplicações domésticas e industriais e especialidades químicas para vários mercados industriais.  As receitas da Phibro são superiores a US$ 1 bilhão e são suportadas por mais de 2.300 colaboradores em todo o mundo.  Na Phibro, as pessoas são nosso maior patrimônio. Nós nos esforçamos para desenvolver uma força de trabalho diversificada que promova um ambiente onde as pessoas se sintam apoiadas em compartilhar abertamente sua criatividade e habilidades que lhes permitam ser o mais bem-sucedidas possível. Se você está interessado em trabalhar para a Phibro, mas sente que não atende todos os requisitos, recomendamos que você se candidate, pois pode ser o candidato certo para esta posição ou outros processos seletivos.  Responsabilidades   Liderar o desempenho técnico e comercial da linha de produtos sob sua responsabilidade nos países da região South America Region (SAR), assegurando crescimento sustentável, rentabilidade e posicionamento competitivo.  Atuar de forma integrada entre as áreas técnica e de marketing, sendo responsável pelo planejamento, implementação e acompanhamento das estratégias regionais, garantindo a correta aplicação dos produtos e fortalecendo a credibilidade da marca nos mercados da região.  Desenvolver e executar anualmente o Plano Estratégico de Marketing da linha, estabelecendo metas claras de volume, margem e posicionamento.  Definir e comunicar a proposta de valor dos produtos, traduzindo diferenciais técnicos em argumentos comerciais consistentes e relevantes para o mercado.  Gerenciar o portfólio regional, revisando o mix de produtos e identificando oportunidades de lançamentos, atualizações ou descontinuações com base no ciclo de vida, desempenho e potencial de mercado.  Estabelecer e revisar estratégias de precificação, equilibrando competitividade e rentabilidade.  Monitorar mensalmente os indicadores-chave de desempenho (volume, preço e lucratividade), propondo ajustes estratégicos conforme necessário.  Gerir o orçamento de marketing da linha, garantindo alocação eficiente dos recursos e avaliação de retorno sobre investimento.  Liderar o desenvolvimento de campanhas e materiais de marketing em parceria com equipes internas e agências, incluindo conteúdos técnicos e promocionais.  Acompanhar o mercado e a concorrência, produzindo análises que subsidiem decisões estratégicas e oportunidades de crescimento.  Participar do processo de S&OP, assegurando alinhamento entre planejamento de marketing, previsão de demanda e disponibilidade de produtos.  Planejar e coordenar estudos de campo, testes e validações científicas, garantindo consistência técnica e conformidade regulatória.  Desenvolver e fortalecer relacionamentos com consultores, universidades e formadores de opinião (KOLs), ampliando a credibilidade técnica da marca.  Participar de visitas estratégicas e discussões técnicas com clientes-chave, contribuindo diretamente para decisões, relacionamento e posicionamento da marca.  Priorizar atividades de alto impacto, evitando envolvimento em rotinas operacionais de campo.  Conduzir treinamentos técnicos internos durante reuniões periódicas, promovendo a capacitação contínua da equipe de vendas.  Assegurar conformidade regulatória em todas as recomendações técnicas e materiais desenvolvidos.  Representar a empresa como porta-voz técnico em eventos, congressos e fóruns do setor.  Promover o alinhamento técnico entre os países da região (SAR), compartilhando melhores práticas e padronizando o posicionamento dos produtos.    Formação & Especializações   Graduação em Medicina Veterinária ou Zootecnia.  Pós-graduação em Marketing, Gestão de Negócios ou áreas correlatas.  Conhecimento do mercado de avicultura. title: Digital Performance Analyst
description:
Empresa está contratando Digital Performance Analyst em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Company Overview  BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. We empower enterprises to innovate at scale, bringing governance, control, and observability to every automation project. Our philosophy is simple: automation is software, and software deserves the same high-code standards that drive innovation in AI and machine learning.  We recently raised a $12M Series A, led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and top industry leaders such as Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source), and Walter Kortschak (Summit Partners | Firestreak Ventures). With 1,000+ customers in 70+ countries, including Bayer and LG, and recognition by G2 (2024) as one of the world’s top 25 emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast.  We’re a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation. If you’re looking for an environment that values impact, autonomy, and excellence, we’d love for you to join us on this journey.  Role Overview  The Digital Performance Analyst will be responsible for BotCity's paid digital strategy end-to-end — from campaign architecture to results analysis — driving demand generation and reducing the company's dependence on events as the primary growth lever. We are looking for a data-driven performance professional with deep expertise in B2B paid media, who understands the full funnel and can translate marketing signals into decisions that matter to sales, CS, and product. The ideal candidate operates with high autonomy, runs parallel hypothesis tests with speed, and is completely detached from what was built before — what matters is learning fast. This role reports to the Marketing Manager.  Responsibilities   Own the end-to-end strategy of paid digital campaigns (Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads) — from planning to optimization and reporting.  Own and manage the paid media budget across all active platforms — allocating spend by channel and campaign objective, tracking pacing against monthly and quarterly targets, identifying waste or underperformance early, and recommending reallocation when needed. title: Team Lead - BSS Business Analysts
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Team Lead - BSS Business Analysts em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're Building The Future Of How The World Communicates.  Netcracker, part of NEC Corporation, combines deep telecom industry expertise with cutting‑edge cloud‑native and AI‑powered innovations to enable communications service providers and enterprises to transform their businesses, unlock innovation, and create meaningful digital experiences for millions of people around the world. With more than 30 years of experience serving over 250 customers in more than 70 locations worldwide, we are the global market leader in telecom software and services.  Join us and be part of a team that is not just keeping up with the digital future but is leading the way.  Job Summary  We are looking for a Lead BSS Business Analyst to join our Implementation Engineering teams located throughout the LATAM region. As a BSS Domain technological subject matter expert (SME), you will be responsible for leading a team providing cost‑effective solution to business and technical challenges faced in large/complex Telecommunication projects. Business Analysts are working as the company’s representatives in front of the enterprise customer.  Responsibilities   Guide the leadership service provider to better understand and articulate the challenges.  Define and document measurable criteria for solution assessment, proposing solution(s) and bring best practice. It is expected that you will have recognition in the Telecommunication industry as a BSS Domain SME.  Focus on ensuring the quality of business requirements for enterprise client. You will provide "best practice" in understanding the client requirements, Telecom products and network aspects in order to align the business’s needs.  The key element of the role is focused on analysis, project design, which can be delivered through the baseline capabilities of existing product. Most important - stakeholder management as well as expectation management.  Collect business requirements for Business‑to‑Business telecom products on various network technologies.  Guiding and coaching the business stakeholders through the requirements gathering process.  Guiding and leading a team of Junior BAs.  Provide clarification and act as a point of reference for business requirement inquiries by solution design and project delivery teams.  Work with project teams agreeing approach and keeping them informed of progress.  Facilitate workshops required to understand and outcome, detailed requirements, and solution behavior.  Work closely with delivery team to ensure functional and non‑functional completeness of the solution.  Create comprehensive and unambiguous documentation that outlines stakeholder requirements, traceable for testing team and understandable for development team. Develop comprehensive knowledge of the aligned business area and the trust of its business stakeholders.    Skills And Experience   8+ years of sufficient technical knowledge to understand high‑level architecture and technical requirements around BSS/OSS/CRM solutions for Telecoms projects.  Experience with BSS (CRM, Quotation, Catalog), OSS (Provisioning, Activation, Inventory) and Billing required.  Strong business analysis background, preferably in a telecom company.  Team Organizational skills, able to work simultaneously on a number of assignments when required.  Knowledge of business analysis principles and methodologies including the applicability of different methodologies to different environments and teams.  Proven ability to work BSS/OSS functionally to drive the accurate capture of requirements, resolving and closing down issues and information shortfall as and when they appear.  Experience of working within Waterfall & Agile methodology.  Ability to collaborate and solve challenges.  Proven experience of successfully working within business and/or IT transformation projects, or projects with B2B products.  Fluent in English & Portuguese languages.  Availability to work from the office in a Hybrid mode (at least 3 times per week).    Education   Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.    All of our job opportunities in Brazil are open to people with disabilities (PWDs)/ Todas as nossas oportunidades de vagas no Brasil são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PCDs).   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Supervisor(a) de Limpeza (Temporário)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Supervisor(a) de Limpeza (Temporário) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

O(a) Supervisor(a) de Limpeza é responsável por coordenar e supervisionar todas as operações diárias de limpeza em todo o campus escolar. Isso inclui salas de aula, banheiros, escritórios administrativos, áreas externas, instalações esportivas, espaços para eventos, áreas internas e externas.  O profissional atuará em estreita colaboração com o Gerente de Facilities para implementar procedimentos de limpeza, responder às solicitações de serviço e garantir que todos os ambientes permaneçam limpos, seguros e acolhedores para alunos, colaboradores e toda a comunidade escolar.  Jornada de Trabalho: Segunda a sábado.  Principais Responsabilidades   Planejar e supervisionar as atividades diárias da equipe de limpeza, padrões de qualidade e escalas de trabalho;  Ajustar cronogramas para garantir cobertura em horários de pico, programas especiais e eventos escolares;  Monitorar presença, pontualidade e desempenho da equipe.  Realizar inspeções diárias em todos os prédios e áreas externas; manter registros de inspeção; priorizar áreas de grande circulação;  Identificar riscos como derramamentos, odores, entupimentos e comunicar às equipes responsáveis para ações corretivas.  Apoiar o processo de contratação de posições da empresa terceirizada de limpeza. Fornecer treinamentos relacionados aos procedimentos específicos da escola, padrões, rotinas e expectativas de segurança, garantindo que a empresa contratada realize todos os treinamentos técnicos sobre métodos de limpeza, uso de produtos químicos e padrões operacionais conforme seus protocolos internos.  Trabalhar em conjunto com o fornecedor para reforçar conformidade com EPIs, práticas de segurança e expectativas de desempenho.  Manter registros de estoque, assegurar armazenamento correto de produtos químicos, verificar rotulagem e procedimentos de diluição, identificar necessidades de manutenção preventiva e solicitar reposição antecipadamente.  Cumprir políticas da escola e regulamentações locais; desenvolver e atualizar POPs (Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão);  Promover manuseio seguro de produtos químicos, diluição adequada e descarte seguro de resíduos.  Comunicar-se com colaboradores, liderança e outros departamentos para discutir necessidades de limpeza, tratar reclamações e preparar relatórios operacionais, desempenho da equipe e acompanhamentos.  Executar tarefas de limpeza quando necessário para cobrir ausências ou demandas urgentes;  Atuar como exemplo de procedimentos para a equipe.  Coordenar preparação e limpeza antes e depois de eventos, assembleias, reuniões e celebrações escolares;  Garantir que os espaços retornem às condições padrão.  Abrir chamados de manutenção para quaisquer problemas identificados, garantindo que tudo permaneça em condições ideais.  Executar outras atividades correlatas conforme designado pela administração.     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Technical Product Marketing Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Technical Product Marketing Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Toradex  is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.  About Toradex  Toradex is a leading provider of embedded computing solutions, specializing in powerful, reliable, and easy-to-use hardware and software for IoT, industrial automation, medical devices, and other verticals. With a focus on high-quality, reliability, ease-of-use, and a strong developer experience, Toradex offers a range of System on Modules (SoMs), accompanying accessories and carrier boards, customization services, a full-stack software offering facilitating cyber regulations compliance, and much more. Headquartered in Switzerland, with offices across the globe, Toradex is committed to empowering developers and businesses by delivering innovative, high-quality solutions that reduce complexity and accelerate time to market.  Job Description  As a Technical Product Marketing Manager at Toradex, you will shape how the market understands, values, and adopts our embedded computing solutions. You will turn complex technical capabilities into clear, differentiated, and commercially compelling product narratives for technical B2B audiences.  The ideal candidate combines strong B2B Product Marketing skills with technical curiosity and the ability to build credible narratives for complex products. You do not need to be the deepest technical expert in the room, but you must be able to understand technical products, ask the right questions, and translate technical value into messaging that resonates with developers, engineers, and business decision-makers. A technical degree is a plus, but proven experience marketing technical B2B products is more important.  Goals   Main Goal   Drive awareness and accelerate adoption of Toradex products by shaping clear market perception, building strong technical product narratives, and ensuring consistent, impactful communication across all touchpoints. This is first and foremost a Product Marketing role, focused on positioning, messaging, product storytelling, sales enablement, and go-to-market content, in close collaboration with Product Management, Sales, Demand Generation, Design, and technical stakeholders.   Key Responsibilities    Positioning & Messaging:  Own and develop product positioning, messaging frameworks, value propositions, and product narratives. Translate technical specifications and product capabilities into clear customer benefits that resonate with technical and business audiences. Ensure product narratives reflect real customer needs, market dynamics and technical buying considerations.  Technical Product Storytelling:  Build credible, compelling narratives around Toradex’s embedded computing solutions. Work with Product Management, Engineering and Sales teams to understand technical details, validate claims, and communicate complex topics in a clear and engaging way.  Go-to-Market Support:  Support product launches by defining messaging frameworks, preparing launch content, coordinating enablement materials, and ensuring cross-functional alignment across Product, Sales, Demand Generation, Design, and Marketing.  Sales Enablement:  Create and maintain sales enablement resources that help sales and customer-facing teams communicate product value effectively. This may include sales decks, one-pagers, FAQs, battlecards, demo narratives, training materials, objection-handling support.    Desired Candidate Profile  Must Have:    Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or another technical field.  At least 3 years of professional experience in Product Marketing within a B2B technology or technical product environment.  Strong experience developing positioning, messaging, product narratives, and sales enablement materials.  Proven ability to translate technical product capabilities into clear, compelling value propositions for technical and business audiences.  Experience marketing complex or technical B2B products to developers, engineers, system architects, product teams, technical buyers, or enterprise decision-makers.  Experience supporting technical product launches, technical sales enablement, demo narratives, or competitive differentiation.  Strong English communication skills, written and spoken.   Available to work Hybrid from Toradex Office in Campinas/SP.   Ability to collaborate effectively with Product Management, Sales, Demand Generation, Design, and technical stakeholders.  Data-driven mindset with the ability to measure, learn from, and iterate on marketing effectiveness.  Proven ability to lead by influence across teams and functions.    Nice to Have:    Familiarity with embedded systems or related hardware/software technologies.    What we offer   An agile and inter-cultural work environment  Working with latest IoT computer technology in an international environment  Participation in defining processes and your working environment  Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment  Opportunities for your personal development  Meal allowance (flash card)  Health and dental care  Parking space  Anniversary day off    Disclaimer: This is not a temporary role. It is a long-term, full-time opportunity.   Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.  We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Key Responsibilities   Positioning & Messaging:  Own and develop product positioning, messaging frameworks, value propositions, and product narratives. Translate technical specifications and product capabilities into clear customer benefits that resonate with technical and business audiences. Technical Product Storytelling:  Build credible, compelling narratives around Toradex’s embedded computing solutions. Work with Product Management, Engineering and Sales teams to understand technical details, validate claims, and communicate complex topics in a clear and engaging way.  Go-to-Market Support:  Support product launches by defining messaging frameworks, preparing launch content, coordinating enablement materials, and ensuring cross-functional alignment across Product, Sales, Demand Generation, Design, and Marketing.  Sales Enablement:  Create and maintain sales enablement resources that help sales and customer-facing teams communicate product value effectively. This may include sales decks, one-pagers, FAQs, battlecards, demo narratives, training materials, objection-handling support.    Desired Candidate Profile  Must Have:   Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or proven technical marketing experience  At least 3 years of professional experience in Product Marketing within a B2B technology or technical product environment.  Strong experience developing positioning, messaging, product narratives, and sales enablement materials.  Proven ability to translate technical product capabilities into clear, compelling value propositions for technical and business audiences.  Experience marketing complex or technical B2B products to developers, engineers, system architects, product teams, technical buyers, or enterprise decision-makers.  Experience supporting technical product launches, technical sales enablement, demo narratives, or competitive differentiation.  Strong English communication skills, written and spoken.   Available to work Hybrid from Toradex Office in Campinas/SP.   Ability to collaborate effectively with Product Management, Sales, Demand Generation, Design, and technical stakeholders.  Data-driven mindset with the ability to measure, learn from, and iterate on marketing effectiveness.  Proven ability to lead by influence across teams and functions.    Nice to Have:   Familiarity with embedded systems or related hardware/software technologies.    What we offer   An agile and inter-cultural work environment  Working with latest IoT computer technology in an international environment  Participation in defining processes and your working environment  Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment  Opportunities for your personal development  Meal allowance (flash card)  Health and dental care  Parking space  Anniversary day off    Disclaimer: This is not a temporary role.
